newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles up as Kleinwort rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles up as Kleinwort rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles Plc rose to a record high on Friday as analysts at Kleinwort Benson rated the stock a "buy" in a research report, market sources said.
The stock was up 45p at 675 by 1134 GMT in volume of 120,503 shares. Earlier it reached 678p, surpassing the previous high of 635p set yesterday.

On Wednesday Biocompatibles said it planned to raise about 45.5 million stg through a rights issue to fund the acquisition of a series of advanced surgery products designed by Canada's Divysios Solutions Ltd.
It said it expects the first products from its collaboration with the Canadian firm to reach the market next year.
Analysts at Kleinwort declined comment on reasons for the recommendation.
Biocompatibles shares were trading at around 160p until the end of August last year.
